chunks: The people of the Wood called the messengers liars.
ai.seo_question: Who were the People of the Wood in the Quran?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Ash-Shu'ara references the people of Al-Aykah, traditionally identified as the Midianites, who rejected Prophet Shu'ayb. In Shia exegesis, this narrative underscores the continuity of divine guidance and the recurring theme of 'kudhb' (denial) by those who knew the truth but chose arrogance, serving as a warning to the Quraysh.
